jurisdiction_name: GROVE CITY COUNCIL WARD 5 (GROVE CITY-CITY City)
narrative: Grove City Council Ward 5 (City of Grove City-city) has 5,762 registered voters, with 59.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 21.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 18.7%, a modest Republican lean of 3.2 percentage points.
